title: God of Mercy, God of Grace
description: God of Mercy, God of Grace in Tonic Solfa to SPANISH HYMN, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Henry Francis Lyte wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 71.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens, six lines (7.7.7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SPANISH HYMN; any other Sevens, six lines tune fits them as well.
underlay: God of mer-cy, God of grace, Show the bright-ness of Thy face! Shine up-on us, Sa-vior, shine, Fill Thy Church with light di-vine, And Thy sa-ving health ex-tend Un-to earth’s re-mo-test end.

lines: God of mercy, God of grace,
Show the brightness of Thy face!
Fill Thy Church with light divine,
Let the people praise Thee, Lord!
Be by all that live adored;
Let the nations shout and sing
Glory to their Lord and King,
At Thy feet their tribute pay,
Let the people praise Thee, Lord!
Earth shall then her fruits afford,
God to man His blessing give,
One in joy and light and love.

licence: Public domain: Henry Francis Lyte died in 1847.
credits: Words by Henry Francis Lyte (1793–1847), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to SPANISH HYMN by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
